checks.name: P.1 every export without renderFrame ran (one tile each, section overlay once per tile on the 2D ones)
R.1 the route draws one frame per tile, and never the composer path's extras: no per-tile fog, no section overlay
R.2 the fog image is the fog alone on a transparent ground: only the shader's paper-white veil at the poche, the near block and open paper
R.3 ...full past End, part-way inside the fade
R.4 registration: the fog image laid over the unfogged picture gives the fogged drawing at the same pixels (mid, far)
R.5 supersampled (4): the same fog, averaged through the sample target (far full, near and paper clear, mid as the 4-sample fogged drawing)
R.5b ...and on the supersampled road (linear buffer, sRGB on present) the fog stays paper WHITE, never the grey a colour a step under its alpha gives
R.6 a drawing with its fog off gives an entirely transparent image
R.7 the canvas is bound again and the renderer back at its own size after the route (1 and 4 samples)
R.8 a picture baked straight after the route is pixel-identical to one baked before it (nothing left behind)
